cases.name: custom_method
cases.after_source:
#[derive(Clone,Copy,Debug,PartialEq)] pub struct Count(pub u32); impl std::ops::Div for Count { type Output=Self; fn div(self,rhs:Self)->Self { Self(self.0 / rhs.0) } } impl Count { pub fn div_ceil(self,rhs:Self)->Self { Self(self.0.div_ceil(rhs.0)) } } pub fn calc(a:Count,b:Count)->Count { a / b }
#[cfg(test)] mod tests { use super::*; #[test] fn examples(){ assert_eq!(Count(11)/Count(4),Count(2)); assert_eq!(calc(Count(11),Count(4)),Count(3)); } }
